hook: Swift actors are safe, until they are not.
hookText: Swift actors and the reentrancy trap

beats.say: An actor lets only one task run at a time, so your state is safe, but it does not guarantee a function runs start to finish.
Every await is a pause where other work can run, so ten cells asking for the same avatar can trigger ten downloads.
The fix is to cache the in-flight task, not just the result, so later callers join the same download.
